# Third-party data

## maternal_health_risk.csv

- Source: Ahmed, M. and Kashem, M. A. (2020). *Maternal Health Risk*.
  UCI Machine Learning Repository, dataset 863.
  https://doi.org/10.24432/C5DP5D (also mirrored on Kaggle).
- Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).
- Changes: none to the file contents; renamed from
  `Maternal Health Risk Data Set.csv`.
- Columns: Age, SystolicBP, DiastolicBP, BS (blood sugar, mmol/L),
  BodyTemp (deg F), HeartRate, RiskLevel (low / mid / high risk).
- Note: 1,014 rows, of which 452 are unique. MamaGate's external check
  deduplicates before reporting.
